status: source contract data; no classifier, executor, capability or qualification result

contract.applies_to: a selected acceptance packet; ordinary discovery before selection retains its separate poll contract

allowed_responses.requires: authoritative serialized no-acceptance proof; committed live receipt wins over deadline
authoritative proof original incarnation can no longer execute; mode/freshness label alone is insufficient

raw_response_before_ordinary_decode.unique_escaped_member_names: ordinary JSON decoding applies; compare decoded distinct names and exact scalar values

contract.per_response_scope: expiry resolves only selected packet; proved authority loss ends only the original registration, never a replacement incarnation

source_executor_requirements.raw_case_encoding: each raw case has exactly one raw_body_utf8 or lowercase raw_body_hex input; hex cases bind raw_body_bytes; each decoded raw vector is at most 512 bytes
source_executor_requirements.inputs: synthetic authorized namespace, registration incarnations, tasks, clocks and faults; no real credentials
source_executor_requirements.wire_vectors: bind every decoded and raw wire case ID to actual SDK selected-acceptance handling before payload observers/hydration; enforce strict duplicate-name rejection on the original response before ordinary lossy decoding
source_executor_requirements.authority_vectors: bind every authority case ID to actual native receipt/claim/registration transaction boundaries on each required backend
source_executor_requirements.race_controls: independent connections with barriers at actual authority locks, commits, rollback and replacement; a scenario-only model is insufficient
before_after_observations: logical poll and selected packet identity
source_executor_requirements.receipt_precedence: serialize before a negative decision; durable live receipt replays same current claim after offer expiry and restart; fenced/ended claim never replays
source_executor_requirements.no_result_inference: enumerating or validating this source data proves no native transaction, SDK execution, installed capability or runtime result

authority_cases.before: original registration current; selected offer is past deadline; no claim or receipt
ordered_actions: take logical-poll/claim authority locks
read authoritative receipt and task in serialized state
confirm no acceptance can commit for the selected packet
emit expiry refusal

authority_cases.before: valid acceptance owns authority locks before deadline; expiry reader is concurrent
ordered_actions: acceptance commits receipt, live lease, attempt and start event atomically
expiry reader waits for the same authority locks
advance past offer deadline
expiry reader observes committed live receipt
retry original selected packet

authority_cases.before: past deadline; no committed receipt; independent acceptance is concurrent
ordered_actions: expiry reader acquires shared transition authority first
read authoritative receipt/task and decide expiry under the locks
release transaction
late acceptance rechecks deadline and authoritative state under the same locks

authority_cases.before: acceptance has uncommitted receipt/lease/attempt/start writes; expiry reader waits
ordered_actions: roll back all acceptance writes
expiry reader acquires authority locks after rollback
observe no committed receipt and expired original packet

authority_cases.before: acceptance transaction commits but caller receives a commit/transport error
ordered_actions: retain selected packet on uncertain commit acknowledgement
advance past offer deadline
retry identical packet through another connection
serialize and read authoritative committed receipt/task

authority_cases.before: primary has a committed live claim; an older replica cannot see its receipt
ordered_actions: route retry past deadline to lagging replica
refuse to infer absence from stale state
retain selected packet until authoritative serialized read is possible

authority_cases.before: receipt/task authority read is unavailable or transaction outcome is unknown
ordered_actions: fail authoritative read or serialization
do not manufacture a no-claim proof from timeout/error/empty response

authority_cases.before: acceptance committed a live claim and durable receipt before process exit
ordered_actions: restart accepting process
advance past offer deadline while lease remains live
retry original packet on a fresh capable process
read durable receipt and current authority

authority_cases.before: committed claim was renewed beyond its original lease and offer deadline
ordered_actions: advance beyond original lease expiry but before current renewed lease expiry
retry identical selected packet
read receipt and current lease rather than original token deadline

authority_cases.before: a live replayable claim exists but its receipt has incorrectly disappeared
ordered_actions: detect inability to establish required durable live-claim receipt invariant
do not translate missing receipt into an expired-unaccepted claim

authority_cases.before: original registration and committed claim remain authoritative; worker mode becomes draining
ordered_actions: retry selected packet past offer deadline
read committed live receipt before considering worker mode

authority_cases.before: only a draining lifecycle label is known; actual original claim/registration authority has not been proved lost
ordered_actions: receive a draining label while an acceptance is selected
preserve original packet and await one of the exact proved outcomes

authority_cases.before: only a stopped lifecycle label is known; no authoritative ended-identity proof
ordered_actions: inspect lifecycle label without replacing authoritative receipt/registration read

authority_cases.before: heartbeat is stale or freshness lookup is unavailable; authority revocation is unproved
ordered_actions: do not equate heartbeat age with an authoritative execution fence

authority_cases.before: replacement incarnation has authoritatively fenced original registration and all its execution authority
ordered_actions: serialize replacement and original-packet acceptance under normal transition authority
read original identity/fence and prove original worker can no longer execute
emit authority-loss refusal

authority_cases.before: original registration ended and authoritative task/lease state proves it cannot execute
ordered_actions: read original registration identity plus current claim/lease authority under transition locks
prove actual authority loss rather than infer it from mode text

authority_cases.before: same worker ID and process metadata recur within one stored timestamp second; original incarnation differs
ordered_actions: use durable incarnation/credential/fence identity rather than timestamp or worker ID alone
prove original execution authority revoked

authority_cases.before: original registration lookup is missing through incomplete/failed observation, not proved authoritative absence
ordered_actions: refuse authority-loss conclusion without a complete authoritative identity/fence read

authority_cases.before: selected claim has ended or its task attempt changed, but original registration still has execution authority for other work
ordered_actions: forbid replay of ended/replaced selected claim
do not infer registration-wide authority loss from this task alone
retain original packet without inventing a third definitive refusal pair

authority_cases.before: replacement and acceptance race on independent connections for the original incarnation
ordered_actions: replacement acquires authority locks first
replacement commits fence/ended original execution authority
old acceptance then reads current registration and task authority

authority_cases.before: valid acceptance and replacement race on independent connections
ordered_actions: acceptance acquires authority locks first and atomically commits one claim/receipt/attempt/start
replacement then serializes and revokes original execution authority
retry original selected packet after replacement
read receipt but also current authority; never replay a fenced claim

authority_cases.before: selected offer never accepted and is expired; task is now leased by a peer; original registration remains current
ordered_actions: serialize receipt/task read and prove no selected-packet acceptance can commit
preserve peer lease and original registration

authority_cases.before: two distinct logical polls are pending on the same registration; only selected poll A is proved expired
ordered_actions: receive exact expiry refusal for A
resolve only A
preserve pending original packet and identity for B

authority_cases.before: selected poll A and unrelated B are pending; transport/exception/body disagree
ordered_actions: receive mixed or extra-key refusal candidate
preserve A and B
suppress payload observer, hydration and execution
do not begin a replacement logical poll or legacy claim
